thread.title: Notable Thursday Option Activity: AAPL, CMG, FB

title: Notable Thursday Option Activity: AAPL, CMG, FB
text: January 18, 2018 at 13:21 PM EST Notable Thursday Option Activity: AAPL, CMG, FB Looking at options trading activity among components of the S&P 500 index, there is noteworthy activity today in Apple Inc (AAPL), where a total volume of 373,637 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 37.4 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 152.6% of AAPL's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 24.5 million shares..
